title: Scaling bitcoin off-chain with PIPEs
description:
We talked to Misha Komarov about Bitcoin PIPEs, which enables covenants and ZKP without a soft fork via off-chain computation. Filmed last year in Istanbul at Bitcoin++ Scaling Edition.
